In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Story 1: India’s Battery Storage Challenge
India is rapidly adding battery storage to support its growing solar power capacity. But the focus is no longer just on building bigger batteries—it’s about building batteries that can store electricity for longer durations. As solar power grows, longer-duration storage is becoming critical to keep the grid stable after sunset and reduce energy wastage.
